title: Campaigner Peter Tatchell arrested for carrying ‘globalise the intifada’ placard
summary: The veteran activist called his arrest at Palestine solidarity rally in London an ‘attack on free speech’ Peter Tatchell, the activist and campaigner, has been arrested for holding a placard which displayed the phrase “globalise the intifada” at a pro-Palestine march in London. Tatchell, who attended a Palestine solidarity march in London on Saturday afternoon, held a sign that read: “Globalise the intifada: Non-violent resistance. End Israel’s occupation of Gaza & West Bank.” Continue reading...

title: Pakistan beat Australia to seal cricket series in T20 World Cup warm-up
summary: Pakistan thump Australia by 90 runs in Lahore in second T20 of tour to seal three-match T20 series 2-0.
